title: Mole Bueno
origin: Migrated from Oaxaca Casa Crespo/Mole bueno.docx (file dated 2024-03-07)

steps.action: Broth: boil 30 min, until meat is cooked. Reserve meat and broth separately:
items: 1 turkey, 4 kg (about 9 lb), in pieces (or 25 chicken pieces)

steps.action: Fry in a large skillet, one ingredient at a time, until golden; reserve each:
items: 1½ cups vegetable oil, adding more as needed (save what's left)

items.text: Chiles, a few seconds each, do not burn:

items: 1 cup almonds (140 g), until skins crack
1 cup raisins (150 g), until puffed; hold in water so they stay soft

steps.action: Dry-toast in a lidded pan, stirring constantly, until golden; reserve:
items: ½ cup hulled pumpkin seeds (50 g)

steps.action: Blend until very smooth, with water just to cover:
Cook over medium, stirring constantly, 1 to 1½ hr, until dark and reduced to a paste that pulls cleanly from the pan:
Thin over heat, adding broth gradually, until it coats the back of a spoon:

items: Meat on a platter, covered in mole

edits: Source says to save leftover oil "for frying the pasta"; read as the mole paste
